messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - Streaming tail latency spike detected for /v1/generate-stream. Alerting on p99 > 1.5s across region-us-east-1. Incident channel created.

alex: seeing p95 jump from ~120ms -> 780ms, p99 around 2.3s. Streaming stalls and long tails for ~10m. Heatmap shows spike correlated with requests that have long prefixes (~6k tokens).

maria: logs show a lot of KV eviction chatter around the same time. shard 12 eviction_rate spiked and prefill queue depth grew. Prefill jobs queued >> decode jobs.

jen: confirmed. prefill workers backlog steady at 240, decode workers idle-ish. Looks like prefill vs decode imbalance + slab fragmentation.

alex: posting small log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T10:03:21Z] kv_cache: shard=12 eviction_rate=0.92 prefill_queue=246 decode_queue=38 slab_frag=0.67
[2026-03-15T10:03:22Z] runtime: streaming stall detected conn=... tail_wait=452ms
[2026-03-15T10:03:22Z] prefill: enqueue model=xlarge_v2 req_id=... priority=normal
```

maria: hypothesis — heavy long-prefix workload caused prefill to flood shard 12; eviction thrashing increased decode latency (prefill holds KV pages in transient state), streaming tails exposed p99.

ryan: customer impact check — calling out to metrics: ~3.2% of streaming requests in last 10m had >1s tail; majority from a handful of API keys belonging to two customers (logged). No error rate increase, just latency.

jun: can we throttle prefill for affected shards or move prefill to different shards? Runtime supports per-shard prefill concurrency.

infra-jen: rolling reassigning prefill tasks is low-risk. I can change shard_pre-fill_concurrency for shard 12 to 2 (was 8) via admin API. Recommend also temporarily raising eviction_threshold to avoid aggressive removes.

alex: OK let's do mitigations in order: 1) reduce shard 12 prefill concurrency 8 -> 2, 2) raise eviction_threshold from 0.7 -> 0.85, 3) temporarily increase decode worker count on hot nodes. I'll run commands.

jen: add a quick traffic reroute policy for streaming to prefer warm shards if available. That reduces exposure while mitigations take effect.

alex: running admin calls now:
```bash
# reduce prefill concurrency for shard 12
curl -s -XPOST "https://admin.internal/runtime/shard/12/config" -d '{"prefill_concurrency":2}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
# bump eviction threshold
curl -s -XPOST "https://admin.internal/runtime/global/config" -d '{"eviction_threshold":0.85}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: config-change at commit abc123 -> admin-configs. Rolling update on 3 nodes.

alex: manual check: prefill queue depth on shard 12 dropping (246 -> 40) within 90s. p95 back to ~160ms, p99 trending down to ~900ms.

maria: great. telemetry also shows a 40% drop in eviction_rate for shard 12. Slab_frag still at 0.6 but stable.

ryan: customer impact update: affected customers notified via status page; no API key revokes necessary. Impact window estimated ~10m.

jun: follow-up task: need longer-term fix — prefill scheduling fairness and adaptive backpressure when decode lag increases. Open a ticket to eng-runtime.

infra-jen: as extra safety I'll kick a graceful restart on the three warm nodes that route streaming traffic to rebalance KV allocations. Doing now.

jen: :thumbsup: monitoring will keep an eye for 30m. If anything regresses, we revert or further throttle.

alex: handoff — I'm off in 10. @ryan please take on-call for next 45m. I'll leave dashboards and recent commands in runbook.

ryan: taking handoff. watching p95/p99 and prefill/decode queues. Noted mitigation steps and rollback plan.

incident-bot: NOTE: Post-incident action required — create incident follow-up (owner: jun) and attach perf graphs + slab allocation traces.

jun: I'll own the follow-up and add an eval with long-prefix synthetic load to reproduce. Action items: 1) prefill fairness ticket, 2) shard rebalancer improvement, 3) add alert for prefill/decode queue imbalance.

alex: quick summary for the channel: root cause = KV cache pressure + prefill vs decode imbalance on hot shard (shard 12) leading to eviction thrash and streaming tail stalls. Mitigation = reduce prefill concurrency on shard 12, raise eviction threshold, increase decode workers, graceful node restarts + traffic preference to warm shards. Impact = ~3% streaming requests experienced >1s tail for ~10 minutes. No errors or data loss.

maria: adding logs and graphs to the incident doc now.

ryan: monitoring green for now. I'll escalate if p99 > 1.5s reappears.

jen: thanks all, good quick mitigation. :eyes:

incident-bot: This thread will be archived after incident marked resolved. Remember to include RCA and perf traces in the postmortem.
